<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Market sell-off:</strong> The Sensex and Nifty 50 experienced a significant decline, with the Nifty falling below the 24,000 mark, driven by broad-based selling in banking stocks and concerns over rising crude oil prices.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I19</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I28</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Regulatory updates:</strong> SEBI has introduced simplified rules for mutual fund transmission claims to reduce delays for legal heirs and granted approval to Carnelian Asset Management to enter the mutual fund business.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I11</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I8</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Corporate earnings:</strong> Nestle India reported strong Q1 FY27 results, with net profit surging 48% year-on-year to Rs 975 crore and revenue growing by 25%.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I17</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I18</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Crude oil and bond yields:</strong> Brent crude prices have climbed above $92 per barrel, pressuring the Indian rupee and pushing the 10-year government bond yield to 6.82%.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W4</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W8</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiwFBVV95cUxOSjJfZi1KVjNOdUJEV1FDaDFILU9oUUtnTWJpLXFzcUtYR2dhZG9xS09RM2xVejlRaUdrdnlCejBicUhTUnV6bnQ0dWhQTEpwVGRYWUZkcnBtSC1HSDQ1Nk5XSFpJN2NEd0otM200b2xwYmxwenREb1VrMm84NTFNUWNuQmJKUkVFQldv?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W10</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Geopolitical and trade headwinds:</strong> Market sentiment was further weighed down by Middle East tensions and concerns regarding new US tariff plans, which offset positive momentum from AI-driven rallies on Wall Street.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W5</a></span></li>
</ul>
